labels.name: Post-capillary venule
labels.function: Slow-flow small vessel where the immune complexes collect

labels.name: Immune complex deposits
labels.function: IgG, IgM or IgA bound to antigen along the vessel wall

labels.name: Fibrin deposition
labels.function: Clotting protein laid down in the necrotic vessel wall

labels.name: Neutrophil
labels.function: Inflammatory cell infiltrating the damaged vessel wall

labels.name: Nuclear dust
labels.function: Debris of fragmented white cells; gives the disease its name

labels.name: Extravasated red blood cells
labels.function: Leak in a 360-degree arc, making each lesion round and purple

labels.name: Mast cell
labels.function: Degranulates, driving vasodilation and vascular permeability

labels.name: Dermal edema
labels.function: Leaked tissue fluid that makes the purpura palpable

labels.name: Medium-sized artery
labels.function: Involvement brings necrosis, as in ANCA vasculitis or PAN

labels.name: Malar rash
labels.function: Sunburn-like cheek erythema; nearly always signals SLE

labels.name: Nasolabial fold
labels.function: Spared by the butterfly-shaped facial rash of lupus

labels.name: Heliotrope rash
labels.function: Lilac upper-eyelid sign, pathognomonic for dermatomyositis

labels.name: Discoid lupus erythematosus
labels.function: Scarring plaque; only 10-20% of patients progress to SLE

labels.name: Subacute cutaneous lupus erythematosus
labels.function: Annular scaly patches; up to 90% are anti-Ro positive

labels.name: Gottron's sign
labels.function: Violaceous change over elbows and knees in dermatomyositis

labels.name: Gottron's papules
labels.function: Scaly violaceous papules over the MCP and IP joints

labels.name: Palpable purpura
labels.function: Non-blanching dependent lesions from venule immune complexes
